description:
[RSSAmp] What the directory covers, by how many feeds cover it. Pass query to search the index instead of paging it. Only subjects at least two feeds share are indexed — a topic one blog uses is that blog's own vocabulary, and lives on its page instead. Raise min to find the well-covered subjects.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).

min.description: Only topics at least this many feeds cover. Default 2.

query.description: Search the topic index. A phrase works as well as a slug — "quantum physics" and "quantum-physics" are the same search. Matches are ranked: the exact topic, then topics starting with the term, then topics containing it.

name: rssamplifier_list_topics
title: RSSAmp: List topics
